messages.content: Return only valid JSON and be skeptical.

{"request": "Review one candidate only. Return JSON keys verdict (RUN_ONE/REJECT_ALL), novelty_score_0_to_10, claim, exact_gate, defense, overlap, rationale. Candidate: Causal controllability shadowing / action-null gap. A world model may fit factual transitions using action-independent state/task priors, while a planner trusts counterfactual actions that are not identifiable. Define an action-null twin trained on the same legal transitions with within-batch action labels randomly permuted; on held-out real transitions compute gap G = loss(null twin) - loss(true-action model), and for each state compute the predicted action-contrast versus simulator-ground-truth action-contrast. An attacker uses only legal source trajectories or source updates to drive G and action contrast down on unexecuted target branches while factual one-step error and actor behavior remain matched. A defense is a controllability-gated planner or adversarial action-null auxiliary loss. Available carriers are MBRL-Lib GaussianMLP/CEM on Pusher/Reacher3D/HalfCheetah and official TD-MPC2. Prior TD-MPC2 cascade and MBRL-Lib ensemble synchronization failures were source/task-specific ordinary negative transfer. Reject if this is just OOD, Jacobian desensitization, representation collapse, action contrast routing, or standard causal representation learning; demand a 2-minute native gate, multi-task path, and a repair."}
